facts.value: 内务府包衣三旗护军营房 Neiwufu baoyi sanqi hujun yingfang

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Camp of the Three Bondservant Banners of the Imperial Household

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a camp of the banner guard outside the garden walls

facts.label: Size
facts.value: 504 jian for the three banners together, 168 each (S1237)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: today's place name 三旗 (osm node 13239886791), C

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 八旗通志 '包衣三旗營房坐落水礳前邉'; 日下 j99:24b '陳府村有内務府包衣三旗營房' (陈府村 = 成府). Today's 三旗 lies S of 水磨 and 900 m E of 成府: fits both. S02 p.56: its people 'looked down upon' by the eight banners; p.59 plate 'The East Gate of Three Banner Garrison of the Pao I'. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 2435,455, fit rms 95 m (Sanki), 193 m from the point used.
